d: A visit from the vet awaits one of the park's strangest residents, while the small monkey team lose the battle to save tragic marmoset Koba, who had been taken out of the pet trade.
Alison looks forward to the prospect of baboons being at the park, while recently arrived marmoset Clyde, rescued from the pet trade, braves the great outdoors for the first time.

Eighty-eight capuchin monkeys rescued from a research laboratory in Chile wake up to their first morning at Monkey World. Rodders has a run-in with a sticky melon, and Seamus the chimp comes face to face with alpha male Butch.
Wildlife vet John Lewis is given a run for his money when he tries to sedate two excitable chimps. Plus, the male capuchins get used to life together.

The team are forced to step in when the chimp introduction goes wrong and Ben is injured by the alpha male, orangutan Hsiao-Quai struggles with her ever-growing son Kai, and the park's staff prepare to welcome another baby orangutan into the fold.

Hananya shows that he is not so tough when it comes to needles, while four-month-old woolly monkey Paulo is being hand-reared by Mike and Alison. Elsewhere, the other chimps enjoy a 'banana-fishing' expedition.

Resident capuchin TJ joins the new Chile arrivals, but he seems to be in a mischievous mood, and Alpha male chimp Paddy has to step in and keep his unruly troop in line. Elsewhere, orangutan Amy is pregnant.
A big decision must be made when alpha male Hananya continues to exhibit violent behaviour. Chimps Simon and Eveline, meanwhile, compete in a swing-off and there is some dental surgery to be done.
A baby chimp tries to prove he is grown up enough to go it alone. The Bachelor Boys' reputation, meanwhile, takes a hit when they become frightened of a new toy.
As Zoey the golden-cheeked gibbon goes into labour, the various gibbons in the park seem to know that one of their number is giving birth and have a morning sing-off.

Baby woolly monkey Paulo meets his new family for the first time, young chimpanzee Eddie has fun and games with baby brother Bart, pregnant orangutan Amy gets to grips with a breast pump, and Mad Max the marmoset arrives at the park.

Mad Max meets his new housemates, and chimps Ben and Pip are in shock after another meeting with Hananya. Over in the woolly monkey enclosure, Piquita is the centre of attention and, in Paddy's chimp group, Bart enjoys his first taste of honey.
Pregnant woolly monkey Piquita looks fit to burst, capuchin Sean, over from Chile, is keen to prove that nobody can groom quite like he can, and life hangs in the balance for Blue the ruffed lemur.
